column1: # Pinned SHA-256 digests for the `bundles` release archives consumed by
# tools/ci/m12-check.sh. These are the authoritative hashes maintained for the
# installer and published in the `metalsharp-bundle-manifest.tsv` asset of the
# rejects any archive that does not match its pinned digest, so the M12 gate
# can never silently test tampered or drifted bundle material. Update this
# manifest in the same change that rotates the `bundles` release.
